purpose: Soil-background weed benchmark subset of PhenoBench v1.1.0: thresholds for exclusion, category assignment and size bands. Set before looking at category counts; sensitivity is reported, the values are not tuned to a result.
units: pixels between pixel centres, at the native 1024 x 1024 resolution; no physical size is implied

size_bands_px.note: half-open [lo, hi) on area_px; 100 px is a 10 x 10 square, 1000 is about 32 x 32, 10000 is 100 x 100

exclude.partial: semantic majority is class 4 (under 50% visible per the dataset README)
exclude.touches_border: instance box touches an image edge: the canopy is cut, its span is unknown
exclude.min_area_note: the tiny band is excluded from A, B and C and reported on its own; a 10 x 10 px blob cannot support a boundary-quality score

category_D_dense_or_ambiguous.fragmented: n_components >= 2 and the pixels outside the largest component are at least 5% of the area
category_D_dense_or_ambiguous.note: any one rule puts the instance in D; D is kept and reported, never discarded

category_B_multiple_distinguishable.note: fails A only because another weed is within 32 px or the ring is 50 to 90% background; the near plant is a weed by construction since crops are at least 64 px away

image_level.B_image: at least two instances in A or B

splits.holdout: official val split, every plot; used once for the final comparison
splits.dev_tune: official train split, plots assigned by alternating the sorted plot ids within each date, starting with tune
splits.dev_check: the remaining train plots; for checking an iteration before touching the holdout
splits.smoke: configs/smoke10.json (train); may overlap dev plots, used only to see that code runs
